newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: U.S.-EU breakthrough on manufacturing standards.
newsitem.headline: U.S.-EU breakthrough on manufacturing standards.

text.p: The United States and the European Union (EU) have resolved all outstanding issues on a package of agreements that would let each other's agencies test, inspect and certify manufacturing standards for five categories of products, a senior White House official said on Wednesday.
"In the last 12 hours or so, we've had a breakthrough in our negotiations with the Europeans on reaching a package of mutual recognition agreements," the official said.
"From our vantage point, all major outstanding issues in the negotiations have been resolved satisfactorily."

The official said the agreements, which would be completed within the next few days, would reduce marketing costs for telecommunications equipment, information-technology products, pharmaceuticals, medical devices and recreational boats.
Trade between the U.S. and the 15 EU countries in these products is worth almost $50 billion annually.
